2901b93c: Initialize some variables used for interaction with VA FileMan.
d6e048bd: Initialize VALMBCK variable which is used by VA FileMan functions to determine the action to be taken.
1476a057: Call the SEL^VALM2 routine to allow the user to select entries. If the user does not select any entries, go to the ENQ label. Otherwise, initialize DGJVALM to 0.
db654961: Call the FULL^VALM1 routine to refresh the screen display. Set the VALMBCK variable to 'R' to indicate that the user has made selections.

5191592e: Loop through the selected entries (VALMY array). For each selected entry, extract the internal entry number (DA), the field number (DGJIFNO) from the temporary global ^TMP("DGJIDX",$J,DGJVALM). If DA is not empty, set DGJTEDT to '1^' concatenated with DA, set DGJDFNO to DA, set DIC to the global root ^VAS(393,, and set DGJTYP to the second piece of the 0 node of the entry in ^VAS(393,DA,0). Call the EDIT^DGJTEE2 routine to perform some action on the selected entry, and call the OKD1 routine.
